name: Five Nights at F***boy's: Dancing All Night
summary:
Welcome to the wonderful world of FNaFb: Dancing All Night.

Ever wondered what would happen if the creator of the (s)hit fan games Golden Freddy's Debauchery Simulator and FNaFB SFME decided to make a fan made Five Nights at F---boy's 4 and not take it seriously in the slightest? Five Nights at F---boy's 4: Dancing All Night is the answer to your weirdly specific question!
